text: dsh-web-notes 是面向 DSH Web 的本地笔记插件，在网页聊天界面提供可拖动的笔记入口和侧边面板。用户可以手动创建笔记、保存页面选中文本、按标题内容和标签搜索，并按当前会话或全局范围管理。笔记支持插入当前会话输入框、复制、编辑、删除和 Markdown 预览；没有会话时插入操作退回剪贴板。数据保存在 DSH 主机的本地 JSON 文件中，适合需要复用命令、参数和片段的 Web 用户；不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-web-notes adds a notes dock to DSH Web. Save selected text or create notes, search by title, content, or tags, and organize notes by session or globally. Insert, copy, edit, or delete notes and preview Markdown. Data stays in a local JSON file on the DSH host; no API key is required.

dsh-web-notes 的功能「选中文本保存」：页面选中一段文字后，浮动入口可将选区创建为笔记，并以首行作为标题。 通过笔记面板或页面选区触发，结果保存为笔记或放入当前输入草稿。
dsh-web-notes 的功能「会话与全局笔记」：笔记可绑定当前会话或设为全局，并按全部、当前会话或全局范围筛选。 通过笔记面板或页面选区触发，结果保存为笔记或放入当前输入草稿。
dsh-web-notes 的功能「笔记搜索与管理」：面板支持按标题、正文和标签搜索，并对笔记执行新建、编辑、删除和复制。 通过笔记面板或页面选区触发，结果保存为笔记或放入当前输入草稿。
dsh-web-notes 的功能「插入聊天草稿」：笔记内容可追加到当前会话输入草稿；没有可用会话时会尝试复制到剪贴板。 通过笔记面板或页面选区触发，结果保存为笔记或放入当前输入草稿。
dsh-web-notes 的功能「Markdown 预览」：编辑器检测到 Markdown 格式后可切换预览，并将文本渲染为 HTML 展示。 通过笔记面板或页面选区触发，结果保存为笔记或放入当前输入草稿。

dsh-web-notes README · dsh-web-notes：Floating notes for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) web GUI (dsh web). Keep commands, credentials, parameter values and any other important snippets at hand while working — and feed them back into the conversation with one click.

dsh-web-notes README · Features：- **Floating dock** — an animated notebook icon on the right edge of the chat window, one click away at all times. Drag it anywhere (the position persists); it honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Configurable placement & size** — in **Settings → Plugins → Plugin Configuration** the dock can be set to **floating** (draggable) or **fixed** (pinned to the chat window's top-right corner, not draggable), and the button size to **Small / Regular / Large**. Changes apply live — no reload.
- **Notes panel** — slide-over panel with search, a note list (title, preview, tags, relative time), and per-note actions.
- **Dismissing the panel** — the X, ESC, the dock button, a click outside the panel, and (on touch) a bottom **Close** button all dismiss it. Every dismissal **persists an in-progress draft** instead of losing it; the editor's **Cancel** is the one explicit discard.
- **Touch / coarse-pointer ready** — on touch devices every control grows to at least a 44px target, the per-note actions become a permanent tappable row instead of hover-only pills (which are unreachable without a hover), the resize gutter widens, and a bottom **Close** button lands in t

dsh-web-notes README · From npm：The package is published on the npm registry:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-notes
```

If your default npm registry is a mirror that has not synced the package yet (e.g. npmmirror — read-only, syncs with a delay), install straight from the official registry instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-notes --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

dsh-web-notes README · Verify the install：```sh

```

After restarting dsh web, the notebook icon appears on the right edge of the chat window (see [Usage](#usage)).

dsh-web-notes README · Update：`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so updating is just pnpm's `update` — no manifest edits needed (the profile reconciles its bundle list against what is installed on the next `dsh plugin` run), then restart dsh web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-web-notes

dsh-web-notes README · or pin an exact version:：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-notes@latest --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

> **Mirror sync delay**: publishing goes to the official registry, but mirrors like npmmirror sync on a delay — right after a release your default registry may still serve the previous version (or briefly 404). If an update "does nothing" after a new release, point at the official registry with `--registry https://registry.npmjs.org/`.
dsh-web-notes README · or pin an exact version:：> Updates never touch your notes: they live on the host at `$DSH_HOME/notes/notes.json` and your settings survive an upgrade.

dsh-web-notes README · Usage：1. Click the notebook icon on the right edge of the chat window.
2. Click **New** to write a note (title optional — defaults to the first line), or select any text on the page and click **Save as note**.
3. In the note list:
   - **Insert** — puts the note into the input box of the current session (appended after any existing draft); press Enter to send.
   - **Copy** — copies title + content to the clipboard.
   - **Edit** / **Delete** — manage the note.
dsh-web-notes README · Usage：Notes are searchable by title, content and tags (comma-separated in the editor).

dsh-web-notes README · Configuration：The plugin registers a `notes` settings namespace and a settings card in **Settings → Plugins → Plugin Configuration** (the namespace is also editable via `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):

```yaml
notes:
  enabled: true            # master switch: false hides the dock entirely
  selectionCapture: true   # false disables the selection "Save as note" bubble
  dockMode: floating       # floating (draggable) | fixed (chat window top-right)
dsh-web-notes README · Configuration：All five options are editable live in the settings card; the dock and panel pick up changes immediately.

dsh-web-notes README · Security：Notes may contain credentials, tokens, or other sensitive values. They are stored **in plaintext** in a local JSON file (`~/.dsh/notes/notes.json`, same trust model as `~/.dsh/credentials.yaml`) and are served only to the loopback browser UI. Do not store secrets you cannot afford to expose on this machine, and protect the file with your OS-level user permissions. Exporting/backing up that file also exports every note.

text: dsh-web-notes README · client UI verification that needs no dsh app (see below)：`scripts/verify-touch.mjs` drives `scripts/harness/entry.tsx` — a standalone harness that renders the REAL `NotesDock` component tree with the REAL `NOTES_CSS` against mocked host contracts (notes API, sessions store, settings scope) — in headless Chrome over CDP. It asserts the coarse-pointer adaptation and every dismissal path, and writes `.logs/touch-desktop.png` / `.logs/touch-coarse.png` for visual inspection.

dsh-web-notes README · client UI verification that needs no dsh app (see below)：> The `scripts/cdp-*.mjs` / `screenshot.mjs` probes drive the *running* GUI, so they need that instance's browser auth. dsh ≥ 0.1.5 gates `/` behind a per-process launch token (minted into a signed cookie), so a fresh headless browser gets `401 dsh web authentication required` and never boots the app — open the token URL printed by `dsh web` in the same browser profile, or reach for the harness for client-only checks.

dsh-web-notes README · client UI verification that needs no dsh app (see below)：- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`, `src/service.ts`, `src/routes.ts`, `src/persist.ts`) — cordis plugin row `notes`; CRUD service, atomic JSON persistence, loopback-guarded `/api/notes/*` routes, settings namespace.
- **Browser half** (`src/client/`) — global floating surface mounted on `document.body` (notes have no session dimension); talks to the host through same-origin JSON; inserts into the composer through the official conversation input facade (`ctx.conversation.input.for(actx).setDraft(...)`).
